reason: A Windows-specific DSH compatibility plugin that restores Git Bash operation through runtime environment and service patches, while explicitly disabling restricted-token sandboxing for shell tools; the elevated execution risk requires human review.

summaries.zh: 该插件通过运行时补丁和环境配置修复 Windows 上 DSH 的 Git Bash 终端，并提供配套代理预设，但会绕过 shell 工具的受限令牌沙箱。
summaries.en: This plugin restores DSH Git Bash operation on Windows through runtime patches and environment configuration, adds agent presets, and bypasses the restricted-token sandbox for shell tools.

capabilities: Injects MSYS-related environment variables and Git Bash paths into the runtime
Bypasses the restricted-token sandbox for Windows shell tools
Writes or synchronizes agent preset files under the DSH home directory
